verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents an official CLI at docs.crossplane.io/cli covering three workflows: rendering and testing Composition Functions without a cluster, troubleshooting Compositions and Composite and Managed Resources, and building, installing and pushing packages. That meets the core story. The AI-native angle is only implied by marketing about machine-readable declarative APIs, not shown for the CLI itself. missing for 10: evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g. structured/JSON output, non-interactive scripting guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
